run_index_server: run a FAISS index server on a given port to serve search requests via RPC
create_client_index: create a ClientIndex that connects to multiple remote FAISS index servers by host and port
search_client_index: search across multiple remote FAISS sub-indexes in parallel and merge results using a result heap
set_nprobe_client_index: set the nprobe parameter on all remote FAISS sub-indexes through the ClientIndex
get_ntotal_client_index: get the total number of vectors across all remote FAISS sub-indexes
